newsitem.title: HUNGARY: New Konzum, Zker shrs to be listed.
newsitem.headline: New Konzum, Zker shrs to be listed.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange said it would list on July 22 new shares in tile manufacturer Zalakeramia Rt and trading firm Konzum Rt, stemming from their recent capital increases.

Zalakeramia sought listing of 120,420 registered, ordinary shares with 1,000 forint face value each, while Konzum planned to list 1,125,000 registered, ordinary shares with 400 forint face value each, the bourse said in its official gazette.
Zalakeramia raised its capital privately to three billion forints via the issue of 120,420 shares at 7,000 forints each, subscribed by Credit Suisse First Boston (Europe) Ltd on June 6, it said.
Konzum increased its share capital by a nominal 450 million forints to 1.686 billion via a private share issue.
The new shares were issued at the 400 forint face value and were subscribed by Forlev Kft, the biggest single shareholder in Konzum.

The new Zalakeramia shares provide the same rights as the already listed stocks and entitle bearers to the 1997 dividend. The new Konzum stocks also provide the same rights as the already listed stocks.
